description: This file defines the ClusterClientAdoNetStreamConfigurator class, which helps set up and configure an ADO.NET-based stream provider within Orleans hosting environment. It includes methods for configuring ADO.NET options, cache size, and partitioning for stream queues.

classes.name: ClusterClientAdoNetStreamConfigurator
classes.description: A configurator class for setting up an ADO.NET stream provider in Orleans client, allowing configuration of options, cache, and partitioning.

methods.name: ClusterClientAdoNetStreamConfigurator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the configurator with a stream name and client builder, setting up default services and partitioning.

methods.name: ConfigureAdoNet
methods.description: Method to configure ADO.NET specific options via a provided configuration action.

methods.name: ConfigureCache
methods.description: Method to set the cache size for the stream provider.

methods.name: ConfigurePartitioning
methods.description: Method to set the number of partitions (queues) for the stream provider.
